reason: A focused UI layout plugin that changes the DeepSeek Harness Web UI left session-list sidebar width by patching the served client bundle, with configurable bounds and a startup backup.

summaries.zh: 通过启动时修补客户端文件，调整 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 左侧会话列表栏的拖动范围和默认宽度。
summaries.en: Adjusts the DeepSeek Harness Web UI left session-list sidebar bounds and default width by patching the served client bundle at startup.

capabilities: Patches the served DeepSeek Harness Web UI client bundle at startup
Adjusts configurable sidebar width bounds and default width
Creates a backup of the original client bundle on first run
